items.question: Why does the woman say, "it's a covered patio"?
items.transcript:
M: Welcome to Schmidt's. Are you interested in our hanging plants? I'm happy to help you choose.
W: Please! I got this coupon in the mail for fifteen percent off any outdoor plants. So, I thought I'd see if you have some flower baskets I could hang in my back patio area.
M: These plants here bloom beautifully and do best in direct sunlight.
W: Well, it's a covered patio.
M: OK. Just follow me. We have plenty of plants that do well in shade or partial sun.
59. Where does the man most likely work?
60. What motivated the woman to visit the business?
61. Why does the woman say, "it's a covered patio"?
items.explanation:
Người đàn ông gợi ý cây cần 'direct sunlight' (ánh sáng trực tiếp), người phụ nữ đáp 'it's a covered patio' (đó là sân hiên có mái che) để đính chính rằng chỗ của cô ấy không có nắng trực tiếp -> Chỉnh sửa một sự hiểu lầm (To correct a misunderstanding).

M: I'm sorry. I just ran out of maps. It's been a very busy weekend.
W: Well, I'm just a little concerned since I don't know the trails.
M: I understand. The visitor center is about 400 meters up the road.
W: Oh, that's good to know. Thanks.
53. Where is the conversation taking place?
54. Why does the woman say she is concerned?

options: To point out a place to park

items.question: What does the speaker mean when he says, "there's significant maintenance work on the track ahead"?
items.transcript:
Hello, and welcome to this West Peak Rail service to Archerville. On our train today, you should take advantage of all the services we have to offer-including our caf car, which is fully stocked with refreshments, and the observation car, with its floor-to-ceiling windows. Our wireless Internet service has also been upgraded! You can connect to our complimentary service using the access code printed on your ticket. Now, we're operating on schedule right now, but there's significant maintenance work on the track ahead. I'll continue to provide updates throughout our journey.
86. What is the announcement mostly about?
87. According to the speaker, what can be found on a ticket?
88. What does the speaker mean when he says, "there's significant maintenance work on the track ahead"?
options: The listeners cannot visit a specific station.
The listeners should anticipate some delays.
The listeners may need to plan alternate routes.
The listeners will receive a ticket refund.
items.explanation: Người nói thông báo phía trước có công trường bảo trì đường ray lớn (significant maintenance work). Mục đích là để cảnh báo hành khách rằng tàu có thể sẽ bị chậm trễ (anticipate some delays).
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "we have a full supply of those in stock"?
items.transcript:
Hi. It's Sarai. I'm calling about the new wallpaper patterns that your team submitted. We all really like the geometric prints. I'm almost certain that all of those will be approved for production in several different color schemes. And the wallpaper patterns for children's rooms are all so imaginative. You have some truly creative people on your design team. However, the animal-themed prints you sent-the thing is, we have a full supply of those in stock. Call me back so we can discuss it.
86. What does the speaker's company sell?
87. Why does the speaker praise the listener's team?
88. Why does the speaker say, "we have a full supply of those in stock"?
options: To report that inventory has been completed
To offer to share some supplies with another store
To explain that some designs are not needed
To confirm that a customer's order can be filled
items.explanation:
Tuy nhiên người nói phàn nàn: 'the animal-themed prints you sent-the thing is, we have a full supply of those in stock.' (các mẫu họa tiết động vật... vấn đề là chúng tôi đã có sẵn đủ số lượng). Ý nói không cần thiết kế này nữa (To explain that some designs are not needed).
Đoạn độc thoại (
items.label: implication

items.question: What does the speaker imply when she says, "making a good impression is important"?
items.transcript:
Currently, you're all working on our design project for Takanashi Systems. They like the suggestions you've made so far, such as how to update their logo to make it more modern. That's welcome news because they have high standards. They mentioned they'll be in the area this Friday and expressed interest in visiting our office, so I've invited them. But as I was walking by the workstation area, I noticed a lot of clutter. Please remember that making a good impression is important.
86. What service does the company provide?
87. What does the speaker say about Friday?
88. What does the speaker imply when she says, "making a good impression is important"?
options: She will be providing her business card.
She does not want employees to be late.
She expects workstations to be clean.
She is unsatisfied with some potential job candidates.
items.explanation:
Người nói phàn nàn 'I noticed a lot of clutter' (tôi nhận thấy có rất nhiều sự lộn xộn). Khi nói 'making a good impression is important', cô ấy ngụ ý nhắc nhở nhân viên phải dọn dẹp không gian làm việc sạch sẽ (expects workstations to be clean).
Đoạn độc thoại (

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "total sales revenues are still being calculated"?
items.transcript:
I'd like to thank you all for attending Omnicom Department Store's staff meeting. As you'll recall, six months ago we made a deal with Euphoria sports clothing to sell their merchandise exclusively in our department stores. The hope is that we can attract new customers to our stores by selling this brand. Data show that foot traffic in the department stores containing Euphoria clothing is up twenty percent from last year. Keep in mind, however, that total sales revenues are still being calculated.
92. Who are the listeners?
93. According to the speaker, what happened six months ago?
94. Why does the speaker say, "total sales revenues are still being calculated"?
options: To warn against reaching a conclusion too soon
To offer an excuse for missing an important deadline
To suggest that a budget be revised
items.explanation: Mặc dù lượng khách đến cửa hàng tăng (tín hiệu tốt), nhưng câu nói này có ý cảnh báo mọi người đừng vội kết luận về sự thành công của doanh thu cho đến khi có con số chính thức.
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "The Salazar family has kept the operation small"?
items.transcript:
W-Am: Today, I'll be interviewing the owners of Salazar Olive Oil, one of the best in California for the past two decades. Now—if you're hearing about this olive oil for the first time, you're not alone. The Salazar family has kept the operation small. I'm interested in discussing their business philosophy as well as their new project: an olive oil tasting class on their farm. You'll find out how to register during the interview so you can sign up!
92. Who are today's guests on the podcast?
93. Why does the speaker say, "The Salazar family has kept the operation small"?
94. What will the listeners be able to do after the podcast?
options: To indicate why a product is only sold online
To justify the high price of a product
To suggest that a company is having financial difficulties
To explain why a product is not well-known
items.explanation: Cô ấy an ủi người nghe rằng "if you're hearing about this olive oil for the first time, you're not alone" (nếu bạn mới nghe lần đầu thì cũng bình thường thôi), sau đó đưa ra lý do là vì gia đình này hoạt động với quy mô nhỏ. Mục đích là giải thích lý do độ nhận diện thương hiệu chưa cao.
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "customers often take a while to make their selection"?
items.transcript:
Thanks for coming in early this morning. I wanted to update you on the caf refrigerators that our customers use. We recently installed a new temperature monitoring system. I've noticed that every increase in temperature can be traced to the refrigerator doors being left open for extended periods of time. This is alarming because it compromises the freshness and safety of our food. We all know that customers often take a while to make their selection. I'll be meeting with the management team to discuss ways to address this.
92. Where does the speaker most likely work?
93. What is the speaker concerned about?
94. Why does the speaker say, "customers often take a while to make their selection"?
options: To encourage staff to be attentive
To remind staff of a policy
items.explanation: Người nói đưa ra câu này 'customers often take a while to make their selection' để giải thích nguyên nhân cửa bị mở lâu, qua đó nhấn mạnh vấn đề (alarming problem) về độ tươi ngon và an toàn của thực phẩm.
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "I only use the highest-quality materials in my work"?
items.transcript:
Hi, Ms. Alvarez. I'm calling to let you know I e-mailed the price estimate you requested for the replacement of your metal roof. I'm sure you've received lower estimates from other businesses. But you should know, I only use the highest-quality materials in my work. Please check out the reviews on my Web site if you have any doubts. I know you hoped that I'd complete the project before you go away on your vacation, but I'm completely booked for the month of March. I could start at the beginning of April, though. I look forward to hearing back from you soon.
92. What industry does the speaker most likely work in?
93. Why does the speaker say, "I only use the highest-quality materials in my work"?
94. What does the speaker say could happen in April?
items.explanation: Người nói rào trước rằng khách hàng có thể nhận được báo giá thấp hơn ('received lower estimates') từ nơi khác, nhưng ngay sau đó khẳng định mình chỉ dùng vật liệu chất lượng cao nhất. Mục đích là để biện minh cho mức giá cao của mình.
items.label: implication

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "its models include a display for advertisements"?
items.transcript:
Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to speak at this city council meeting. On behalf of the transportation department, I'd like to present a proposal to fund the replacement of all 350 bus-stop shelters in our city. We feel this is a worthwhile investment because the current shelters aren't in good shape. Many of them have cracked glass and broken benches. We want to go with Urban Retreat because its shelters are made of durable materials. While less expensive options are available, its models include a display for advertisements. These shelters could provide the city with a new source of income.
83. Who is the speaker presenting to?
84. What does the speaker say about some existing structures?
85. Why does the speaker say, "its models include a display for advertisements"?
options: To respond to a request for information
To suggest adding to a product line
items.explanation:
Người nói lập luận: 'While less expensive options are available, its models include a display for advertisements. These shelters could provide the city with a new source of income.' (...các mô hình của hãng này bao gồm bảng quảng cáo... mang lại nguồn thu nhập mới). Dùng để biện minh cho mức giá đắt hơn (To justify a cost).

items.question: Why does the speaker say, "we do use outside suppliers for parts"?
items.transcript:
Ms. Stewart, this is Rodrigo Gomez, president of Gomez and Sons. I want to apologize personally for the problems your restaurant experienced using our patio umbrellas. At our company, we pride ourselves on doing everything in-house, from graphic design to production. This gives us greater control over the quality of our products. But we do use outside suppliers for parts. Apparently, we received some inferior metal components. We will send you a replacement set of umbrellas at no cost today, constructed with new metal parts.
80. What does the speaker's company sell?
81. Why does the speaker say, "we do use outside suppliers for parts"?
82. What does the speaker say he will do today?
options: To explain the source of a problem
items.explanation: Người nói nhắc đến việc dùng nhà cung cấp bên ngoài để giải thích cho sự cố tiếp theo: 'Apparently, we received some inferior metal components' (Rõ ràng là chúng tôi đã nhận được một số linh kiện kim loại kém chất lượng).
items.label: implication

items.question: What does the woman imply when she says, "A week is not a long time"?

W: Hi, Shinji. I wanted to ask you about the order we got from the department store chain. You know, the one that placed an order for 5,000 jigsaw puzzles?
M: Yes. They want the order in a week so they can stock them before the holiday.
W: A week is not a long time.
M: We've had short timelines before. Anyway, our illustrators sent some new puzzle illustrations, right? I heard they're making a special edition.
W: Yes, and I'm so excited! I've got the sketches right here. Let me show you.
59. What does the speakers' company manufacture?
60. What does the woman imply when she says, "A week is not a long time"?

options: Some temporary employees have been hired.
An order may not be filled.
items.explanation: Khách hàng muốn có hàng trong một tuần. Việc người phụ nữ nói 'A week is not a long time' thể hiện sự lo ngại thời gian quá gấp và đơn hàng có thể không kịp hoàn thành.

items.question: Look at the graphic. Where do the speakers decide to install some bicycle racks?

drills.title: Nghe trọn bộ — Part 4

items.question: What is the purpose of the meeting?

Good morning, Glenman House Living Museum staff. Recently, researchers discovered the original plans for the house's gardens from the eighteenth century. So, we're going to restore the gardens based on those plans! Even though we have the original designs, making an authentic re-creation won't be an easy task. We don't know what specific varieties of plants were grown back then. That's why we're so lucky to have Vivek Hazarika consulting on this project. As a gardener who has managed the grounds of many historic estates, he has extensive expertise in what would have been planted at the time.

Thank you for attending Port Jefferson's city council meeting. We have a lot on our agenda today. The first topic up for discussion is a request from the head of the city's water system. He wants to buy two UAVs-or underwater autonomous vehicles. These remotely operated vehicles can be used to inspect, maintain, and repair equipment underwater. Now, each UAV costs 30,000 dollars, so this is a big decision for us. But for perspective, the city spends more than that every year to hire divers to repair broken equipment. Let's hear more about it from the chief engineer. He's going to give us some details about the vehicles.
